events.title: Falcon 9 · CRS-35 to the ISS
events.imageCredit: Photo: NASA/Kim Shiflett (CRS-25 liftoff), public domain
events.description: Falcon 9 launches Cargo Dragon C211 on NASA's 35th SpaceX resupply mission from pad 40 at Cape Canaveral, carrying more than 6,300 lb of supplies, science and the final pair of ISS Roll-Out Solar Arrays. The booster is on its eighth flight and will land at Landing Zone 40; Dragon docks with the station on Thursday 15 Oct around 16:00 Irish time.

events.title: Falcon 9 · USSF-481
events.imageCredit: Photo: U.S. Space Force/Senior Airman Samuel Becker, public domain
events.description: A Falcon 9 national security launch for the U.S. Space Force from SLC-4E at Vandenberg, California, with a four-hour window. The payload is classified; the first stage lands on a droneship, and a backup opportunity is on Friday 16 Oct.

events.title: Tesla Roadster demo
events.imageCredit: Photo: Smnt, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0
events.description: Tesla's next-generation Roadster, first shown as a prototype in November 2017, is due for a demo on Thursday 15 Oct. Tesla hasn't announced a start time, so this will switch to live once the official stream is posted on @Tesla.

events.title: Tesla Q3 2026 earnings call
events.imageCredit: Photo: Steve Jurvetson, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 2.0
events.description: Tesla posts its Q3 2026 results after the US market close, then management holds a live Q&A webcast at 4:30pm Central Time. The webcast and replay are on ir.tesla.com, which can't be embedded here.

events.title: Starship Flight 15
events.imageCredit: Photo: Shujianyang, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0
events.description: Starship's fifteenth flight test from Starbase, Texas, targeted no earlier than 8 November. It's expected to be the first serious attempt to catch a Ship back at the tower.
